ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between black peripheral regions and white/yellowish central regions. Visible pixel distribution roughly 35% low-intensity (black/dark brown) and 65% mid-to-high intensity (yellow/white).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region dominated by contiguous brownish-ochre geometric blobs. Perimeters of these blobs are bordered by high-intensity white pixels. Numerous low-intensity, roughly circular focal spots (1-4 pixel radius) are distributed non-uniformly across the entire fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50-55 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the lobes of approximately 1/4 of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with high-amplitude variations. Peaks and valleys along the boundary range from 2 to 15 pixels in depth, creating an extremely irregular, jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groupings (dark brown/black spots) distributed across both lobes, likely corresponding to past barnacle colonization sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge suggesting significant tissue erosion or trauma. Extensive circular scarring patterns across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive yellowish-brown/ochre pigmentation covering approximately 60% of the visible ventral area, contrasting with standard white/black phenotypes.
